nodes.question: How do regulations targeted at consumption compare to those targeted at production in terms of their effects on the development of CEMS?
nodes.answer: Regulations targeted at consumption have a greater effect on the development of CEMS compared to those targeted at production, indicating a focus on consumption as an important driver due to the risks posed by production.
